_comment: The landmark alphabet (docs/game/art-and-audio.md, 'Landmark language'). Every glyph is a real Conway still life, which is why this is data and not invented art: the material language says everything is cells, and Thread 2 says the terrain is made of the ones who stopped. A still life IS one who stopped. Cells are [x, y] on a small grid, origin-normalised. The set is verified pairwise-distinct under rotation AND reflection by GlyphAlphabetTest — parallel transport rotates these, so any two that were rotations of each other would be the same landmark to a player who arrived from a different direction.
